lemma: Scope: Boolean relations of finite arity; pp-definitions as an existential quantification over a conjunction of atoms and equalities; no constants. If S(x_1..x_m) = EXISTS y . phi(x,y) with phi a conjunction of atoms R(...) and equalities, and f is a polymorphism of R (f preserves R coordinatewise), then f preserves S. Proof: let s^1..s^k be tuples in S with witnesses y^1..y^k such that phi(s^j, y^j) holds. Each atom R(z_1..z_r) of phi holds for the k argument tuples (one per j), so applying f coordinatewise to these k R-tuples gives an R-tuple. Assign each variable v the vector of its values across j and set v -> f(vector). Every atom of phi then holds for the image assignment, equalities hold because f acts on identical value columns, so f(s^1..s^k) lies in S with witness f(y^1..y^k). Status: standard fact, recorded as a verified lemma; it is not progress on P vs NP or on the port/transfer target of Q-50565a6d2f.
